Smooth Center Part & Tweed Collar

IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, sleek ash-brown
hair parted at the center, with bright blue-gray eyes and
soft pink lips. A tweed-textured dark collar peeks into
the frame at the bottom. Her expression is calm and
direct. A soft, warm-gray blurred backdrop with natural
light. Palette of ash brown, soft gray, and muted rose.
Clean and sleek, in the style of a runway beauty
close-up.
Clean, sleek, runway
WORKING NOTES
- The sleek center part and clean skin are the focus.
- Use 'extreme close-up' to emphasize the hair texture.
